jellyfish text index | photo index and hydroid text index | photo index Phylum Cnidaria

Class Hydrozoa | jellyfish Thread-tentacled jellyfish
Aequorea sp.
Family Aequoreidaeupdated Aug 2025

Where seen? This small jellyfish sometimes seen on stranded on our shores. Several may be seen, and then none seen again for some time.

Features: Bell about 5-8cm, long thin thread-like tentacles from the edges of the bell 10-15cm long. Bell has radiating white patterns. Those washed ashore look like blobs of jelly.

Status and threats: There is inadequate information as at 2024 to make an informed assesment of its conservation status in Singapore.
